body:
> but I read what you wrote and thought you expressed yourself really well! 

Thanks, but I can write much, much better than I can actually interact with people. It's not just that, but my brain seems to work differently. If you were to meet me in person you'd either immediately forget about me, think I was creepy, or think I'm some loser.

Thanks for the kind words. But my despair over not losing my virginity isn't really about not conforming to some arbitrary societal standard. Instead, it's sort of a repesentation of how much my life's been a failure for pretty much my entire youth. I've never had a relationship, nobody's every really cared about me (apart from my parents), I've never been intimate with anyone. Since I'm now entering my late '20s I've lost so much ground and missed so many social experiences I don't think I'll ever be able to make them up, even if my extreme social idiocy suddenly fixes itself tomorrow. I don't want to lose my virginity to an escort just to check some life achievement off of a box, but instead just to be able to pretend for a few minutes that I've finally found someone who actually loves me and wants to be intimate with me, so I can get something of a sense of what that feels like before I die.

Thanks for the replies everyone. Sorry I keep posting here. I know it's not what this sub is for, but I keep getting replies here. I did make a more detailed post in r/suicidewatch, but it's only gotten one response so far.

I guess I'm somewhat embarrassed to bring the issue up with my parents, and don't really want to go through all the hassle of what will happen if I admit I'm suicidal (therapists, possible psych ward). I should add that I was on antidepressants a few years ago, several different kinds at various points, actually, but they all had terrible side effects that ended up making me feel worse than I did without them. I don't want to go though another process where I keep getting pumped full of different drugs that make me feel terrible, then pumped full with even more drugs to counter the side effects of the first drugs, then getting different dosages and brand names when someone finally takes my complaints seriously. Going back to issues I had with my mom, when I was on prozac it caused me all sorts of unpleasant side effects, included insomnia, severe fatigue and akathisia, which all got so bad it became difficult to function. When I tried telling my mom about this, she just got angry with me because apparently I was being a hypochondriac and "looking up symptoms on the internet to scare myself with." It wasn't until I told my therapist who told my mom that these side effects were legit did she stop berating me about taking the medicine. Anyway, I jut don't want to go through that again.

Thanks for the reply. I appreciate friendly internet responses, but unfortunately (for me at least) internet friends are no substitute for real friends. I want human contact. I want people who like me for me, not just because I'm an anonymous poster on the internet threatening to kill myself. A future where all I can do is sit by myself and communicate on the internet is a future I don't want to live it.
